LodError.description: Why `raul lod generate` did not succeed.

code.description: The stable code callers match on.

lodwright_code.description: For `lodwright_failed` and `unsupported`: lodwright's own `code`, for example `output_not_empty`.

message.description: Prose for people; never matched on.

LodErrorCode.description: The stable error codes of `raul lod generate`. The exit code of each is in `contracts/README.md`.

oneOf.description: The Instance does not exist or cannot be opened (exit code 2).
The Profile does not exist (exit code 2).

No request can be built from the Profile: no Load order, no Staging tree, settings that cannot be read, or
an output folder lodwright refuses (exit code 2).
Not produced: lodwright is linked into `raul`, so there is no program to find (exit code 2).
Not produced: lodwright is linked into `raul`, so there is no program to check (exit code 3).

The generation stopped unexpectedly, ran past the timeout, reported a status that is not `ok`, or the work
folder could not be made (exit code 4).
The output folder holds a manifest of a version this build does not read (exit code 2).
lodwright's generation failed (exit code 4); `lodwright_code` says why.

lodwright cannot do what the request asks yet (exit code 2). Nothing was written. Not produced by the linked
library, which reports such a request as `LodwrightFailed`.
The run was cancelled (exit code 4); the Instance is as it was.
lodwright succeeded but putting its output into the Instance failed and was rolled back (exit code 4).
Done (exit code 0). For a dry run: everything checked, nothing written.
Refused before anything was written (exit code 2).
The Component refused the input as one it does not support (exit code 2); nothing was written.
The program could not be verified against its checksum (exit code 3); it was not started.
A step failed (exit code 4); the Instance is as it was.
Cancelled (exit code 4); the Instance is as it was, and `--resume` continues.

ToolInfo.description:
The Component a driver ran. ttwright and lodwright run in raul's own process, so their `tool` names the raul
executable.

path.description: The file that ran: for ttwright and lodwright, the raul executable.

sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of that file, checked again right before it was started; empty for ttwright and lodwright, which
run in raul's own process and start no file of their own.

version.description: Its version as the program reported it in its result; `null` in the `started` event, before it ran.

description: The result of `raul lod generate` (Contract `raul-lod-result`, version 1), carried by the `result` event.

dry_run.description: A dry run: the request was built and checked, and nothing was run or written.

files.description: Files in the Mod, or `null` when no Mod was written.

lodwright.description: The `lodwright-result` document of the run, as lodwright returned it, or `null` when it returned none.

mod.description: The LOD Mod (`LOD (lodwright)`), or `null` when the run did not get that far.

request.description: The request file, or `null`: lodwright is called in process with the request, so no file is written.

status.description: How the run ended; the same as the `finished` event's.

tool.description: lodwright, linked into `raul` (its name and version), or `null` when no generation started.

up_to_date.description:
lodwright found its earlier output current for the same request and inputs and wrote nothing, and the Mod
was already there: nothing changed.

worlds.description: The worlds the request names; empty for every world with terrain.

title: LodResult
